audit.command: Verify the Filebeat process and management-platform configuration on every production instance: ps aux | grep '[f]ilebeat' # Inspect the effective Filebeat inputs and outputs. grep -E 'type:|paths:|output\.kafka|output\.elasticsearch|hosts:|topic:' \ /path/to/filebeat.yml Confirm that the following required sources are enabled where present: 1. Compute-node interface logs. 2. Compute-node SQL logs. 3. Data-node DB audit logs. 4. Data-node slow query logs. 5. Data-node error logs. 6. Agent sys_log, back_log, and dump_log. 7.

remediation.command: In the TDSQL management platform, open the instance's Filebeat audit-log settings and enable the required compute-node, data-node, and Agent log inputs. Configure an approved Kafka or Elasticsearch destination and use consistent topics and partition rules for equivalent logs across instances. Where DBbrain high-level analysis is licensed, Kafka output may be connected to DBbrain for full-link analysis. DBbrain is optional;

title: Ensure Audit Logs Are Written in Append Mode and Protected from Overwrite
description: audit_txsql_rotate_write_log controls how the TXSQL audit facility handles local audit files. The value is intentionally counterintuitive: OFF uses append mode with date- and size-based file creation, while ON uses circular files that may overwrite earlier evidence. Runs the mysql client against the TDSQL data node selected by TDSQL_MYSQL_OPTS (e.g. "-h10.0.0.5 -P4001 -utdsql_audit"); keep the password in ~/.my.cnf or a login path rather than MYSQL_PWD or the command line (see 1.4 and 1.5). The benchmark rates this recommendation Manual; the automated check covers its objective pass criterion. Run against every primary and replica. Passes when audit_txsql_rotate_write_log is OFF (append mode); also confirm audit files use append-mode names (audit_log.YYYY-MM-DD.ID) and reach the central destination before local cleanup.
reference: CIS Tencent TDSQL 10.3.22 Benchmark v1.0.0 - 6.9 Ensure Audit Logs Are Written in Append Mode and Protected from Overwrite

audit.command: out=$(mysql ${TDSQL_MYSQL_OPTS:-} -NBe "SHOW GLOBAL VARIABLES LIKE 'audit_txsql_rotate_write_log'" 2>/dev/null) || exit 1; v=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | awk -F'\t' '$1 == "audit_txsql_rotate_write_log" {print toupper($2)}'); case "$v" in OFF|0) echo compliant;; *) echo "value '$v'";; esac

remediation.command: SET GLOBAL audit_txsql_rotate_write_log = OFF; persist it through the TDSQL parameter template and configure disk-capacity alerts for the audit directory.

title: Ensure the Default Authentication Plugin Is `caching_sha2_password`
description: The default authentication plugin in MySQL 8.0 is caching_sha2_password, which provides stronger password hashing and challenge-response authentication than mysql_native_password. Runs the mysql client against the TDSQL data node selected by TDSQL_MYSQL_OPTS (e.g. "-h10.0.0.5 -P4001 -utdsql_audit"); keep the password in ~/.my.cnf or a login path rather than MYSQL_PWD or the command line (see 1.4 and 1.5). Also confirm user_auth_plugin = caching_sha2_password in the TDSQL Manager manager.json.
reference: CIS Tencent TDSQL 10.3.22 Benchmark v1.0.0 - 7.1 Ensure the Default Authentication Plugin Is `caching_sha2_password`

audit.command: out=$(mysql ${TDSQL_MYSQL_OPTS:-} -NBe "SELECT @@global.default_authentication_plugin" 2>/dev/null) || exit 1; printf '%s\n' "$out"

remediation.command: Set { "name": "user_auth_plugin", "value": "caching_sha2_password" } in manager.json and default_authentication_plugin = caching_sha2_password in the instance template; migrate accounts after confirming client compatibility.

title: Ensure a Password Expiration Policy Is Configured
description: A password expiration policy forces users to change passwords periodically, reducing the risk of exploitation after long-term credential leakage. Runs the mysql client against the TDSQL data node selected by TDSQL_MYSQL_OPTS (e.g. "-h10.0.0.5 -P4001 -utdsql_audit"); keep the password in ~/.my.cnf or a login path rather than MYSQL_PWD or the command line (see 1.4 and 1.5). Passes when the global default_password_lifetime is greater than 0; also review per-user password_lifetime (SELECT User, Host, password_lifetime, password_expired FROM mysql.user) for accounts created with PASSWORD EXPIRE NEVER.
reference: CIS Tencent TDSQL 10.3.22 Benchmark v1.0.0 - 7.3 Ensure a Password Expiration Policy Is Configured

audit.command: out=$(mysql ${TDSQL_MYSQL_OPTS:-} -NBe "SELECT CASE WHEN @@global.default_password_lifetime > 0 THEN 'compliant' ELSE 'never expires' END" 2>/dev/null) || exit 1; printf '%s\n' "$out"

remediation.guidance: SET GLOBAL default_password_lifetime = 90; or per user ALTER USER '<user>'@'<host>' PASSWORD EXPIRE INTERVAL 90 DAY;

title: Ensure an Account Locking Policy Is Configured
description: An account locking policy automatically locks accounts after consecutive login failures, preventing brute-force attacks. Assessed manually here: the benchmark check is environment-specific and cannot be evaluated reliably by a single command.
reference: CIS Tencent TDSQL 10.3.22 Benchmark v1.0.0 - 7.4 Ensure an Account Locking Policy Is Configured

audit.command: Run SELECT User, Host, User_attributes FROM mysql.user; and confirm business accounts carry FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS (e.g. 5) and PASSWORD_LOCK_TIME (e.g. 1 day) in User_attributes. On the SQLEngine run SHOW VARIABLES LIKE 'tdsql_user_lock_by_ip'; (should be ON). Accounts without a locking policy are a finding.

remediation.command: Set a locking policy when creating or modifying a user: ALTER USER 'username'@'host' FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS 5 PASSWORD_LOCK_TIME 1; Enable SQLEngine's per-IP locking: SET GLOBAL tdsql_user_lock_by_ip = ON; SQLEngine's tdsql_user_lock_by_ip feature tracks failed login counts and locks per source IP, providing finer control than MySQL's native per- account locking.

title: Ensure Password Reuse Restrictions Are Configured
description: Password reuse restrictions prevent users from reusing recently used passwords when changing their password. Runs the mysql client against the TDSQL data node selected by TDSQL_MYSQL_OPTS (e.g. "-h10.0.0.5 -P4001 -utdsql_audit"); keep the password in ~/.my.cnf or a login path rather than MYSQL_PWD or the command line (see 1.4 and 1.5). Passes when password_history >= 5 and password_reuse_interval >= 365.
reference: CIS Tencent TDSQL 10.3.22 Benchmark v1.0.0 - 7.6 Ensure Password Reuse Restrictions Are Configured

audit.command: out=$(mysql ${TDSQL_MYSQL_OPTS:-} -NBe "SELECT CASE WHEN @@global.password_history >= 5 AND @@global.password_reuse_interval >= 365 THEN 'compliant' ELSE 'noncompliant' END" 2>/dev/null) || exit 1; printf '%s\n' "$out"

remediation.guidance: SET GLOBAL password_history = 5; SET GLOBAL password_reuse_interval = 365;

title: Ensure Binary Log Encryption Is Enabled
description: Binary logs record all data modifications and may contain sensitive business data. Enabling binlog_encryption ensures binlog files at rest are encrypted, preventing data leakage if files are exfiltrated. This feature is available in TDSQL 10.3.22.3 and later. Runs the mysql client against the TDSQL data node selected by TDSQL_MYSQL_OPTS (e.g. "-h10.0.0.5 -P4001 -utdsql_audit"); keep the password in ~/.my.cnf or a login path rather than MYSQL_PWD or the command line (see 1.4 and 1.5). Passes when binlog_encryption is ON; also confirm SHOW BINARY LOGS reports recent files as encrypted.
reference: CIS Tencent TDSQL 10.3.22 Benchmark v1.0.0 - 8.3 Ensure Binary Log Encryption Is Enabled

audit.command: out=$(mysql ${TDSQL_MYSQL_OPTS:-} -NBe "SELECT @@global.binlog_encryption" 2>/dev/null) || exit 1; printf '%s\n' "$out"

remediation.command: After KMS and instance data encryption are enabled (8.1), SET GLOBAL binlog_encryption = ON; and persist it in the parameter template.

title: Ensure Encryption Key Rotation Is Configured
description: Encryption master keys should be rotated periodically. TDSQL supports master key rotation via ALTER INSTANCE ROTATE INNODB MASTER KEY, which generates a new key version and re-wraps all data encryption keys (DEKs) using the envelope encryption model-without requiring data re-encryption. Assessed manually here: the benchmark check is environment-specific and cannot be evaluated reliably by a single command.
reference: CIS Tencent TDSQL 10.3.22 Benchmark v1.0.0 - 8.4 Ensure Encryption Key Rotation Is Configured

audit.command: Run SELECT * FROM performance_schema.keyring_keys ORDER BY KEY_ID DESC LIMIT 5; and SHOW GLOBAL STATUS LIKE 'Innodb_encryption_master_key_id'; then review KMS audit logs. The master key must have been rotated within the policy period (e.g. within the last 365 days); no rotation within the period is a finding.

remediation.command: 1. Perform immediate key rotation: ALTER INSTANCE ROTATE INNODB MASTER KEY; 2. Verify rotation success: SHOW GLOBAL STATUS LIKE 'Innodb_encryption_master_key_id'; -- The key ID should increment after rotation 3. Establish a periodic rotation schedule (recommended: every 90-365 days) via operational procedures or automation.

title: Ensure Connection Timeout Parameters Are Reasonable
description: Idle connection timeout parameters (wait_timeout, interactive_timeout) control when idle connections are automatically closed. Excessively long timeouts increase the risk of connection hijacking. Runs the mysql client against the TDSQL data node selected by TDSQL_MYSQL_OPTS (e.g. "-h10.0.0.5 -P4001 -utdsql_audit"); keep the password in ~/.my.cnf or a login path rather than MYSQL_PWD or the command line (see 1.4 and 1.5). Passes when wait_timeout and interactive_timeout are both 3600 seconds or less (300-600 recommended for production; the TDSQL default 28800 fails).
reference: CIS Tencent TDSQL 10.3.22 Benchmark v1.0.0 - 9.4 Ensure Connection Timeout Parameters Are Reasonable

audit.command: out=$(mysql ${TDSQL_MYSQL_OPTS:-} -NBe "SELECT CASE WHEN @@global.wait_timeout <= 3600 AND @@global.interactive_timeout <= 3600 THEN 'compliant' ELSE 'noncompliant' END" 2>/dev/null) || exit 1; printf '%s\n' "$out"

remediation.guidance: SET GLOBAL wait_timeout = 600; SET GLOBAL interactive_timeout = 600; and persist them in the parameter template.

title: Ensure Strong Synchronous Replication Is Used
description: TDSQL's strong synchronous (sqlasyn) mechanism ensures a transaction returns success only after it is confirmed on both the primary and replica nodes, guaranteeing no data loss. Runs the mysql client against the TDSQL data node selected by TDSQL_MYSQL_OPTS (e.g. "-h10.0.0.5 -P4001 -utdsql_audit"); keep the password in ~/.my.cnf or a login path rather than MYSQL_PWD or the command line (see 1.4 and 1.5).
reference: CIS Tencent TDSQL 10.3.22 Benchmark v1.0.0 - 10.3 Ensure Strong Synchronous Replication Is Used

audit.command: out=$(mysql ${TDSQL_MYSQL_OPTS:-} -NBe "SHOW GLOBAL VARIABLES LIKE 'sqlasyn'" 2>/dev/null) || exit 1; v=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | awk -F'\t' '$1 == "sqlasyn" {print toupper($2)}'); case "$v" in ON|1) echo compliant;; *) echo "value '$v'";; esac

remediation.command: SET GLOBAL sqlasyn = ON; through the OSS management platform and persist it in the parameter template.

title: Ensure the Distributed Transaction Mode Is Securely Configured
description: TDSQL supports multiple distributed transaction modes, of which XA_TRANSACTION mode provides cross-shard ACID guarantees. Runs the mysql client against the SQLEngine (compute node) selected by TDSQL_SQLENGINE_OPTS (falls back to TDSQL_MYSQL_OPTS); keep the password in ~/.my.cnf or a login path.
reference: CIS Tencent TDSQL 10.3.22 Benchmark v1.0.0 - 11.3 Ensure the Distributed Transaction Mode Is Securely Configured

audit.command: out=$(mysql ${TDSQL_SQLENGINE_OPTS:-${TDSQL_MYSQL_OPTS:-}} -NBe "SHOW GLOBAL VARIABLES LIKE 'tdsql_transaction_mode'" 2>/dev/null) || exit 1; v=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | awk -F'\t' '$1 == "tdsql_transaction_mode" {print toupper($2)}'); case "$v" in XA_TRANSACTION) echo compliant;; *) echo "value '$v'";; esac

remediation.command: Set { "Name": "tdsql_transaction_mode", "value": "XA_TRANSACTION" } through the OSS management platform.

title: Ensure Gateway Connection Limits Are Configured
description: The TDSQL Gateway connection limit (gateway.security.conn.conn_limit) prevents a single client or attacker from exhausting all connection resources. Assessed manually here: the benchmark check is environment-specific and cannot be evaluated reliably by a single command.
reference: CIS Tencent TDSQL 10.3.22 Benchmark v1.0.0 - 11.5 Ensure Gateway Connection Limits Are Configured

audit.command: In the OSS management platform (or the Gateway proxy.json) check gateway.security.conn.conn_limit for every instance: it must be greater than 0 and sized to the instance specification; 0 (the default, unlimited) is a finding.

remediation.command: Set a reasonable connection limit according to the instance specification and business needs: { "Name": "gateway.security.conn.conn_limit", "value": "5000" }

title: Ensure the Gateway Unsafe-Function Denylist Is Configured
description: The TDSQL Gateway provides an unsafe system function denylist to block the execution of functions that may leak system information or be used for attacks.
reference: CIS Tencent TDSQL 10.3.22 Benchmark v1.0.0 - 11.6 Ensure the Gateway Unsafe-Function Denylist Is Configured

audit.command: In the OSS management platform (or the Gateway proxy.json) confirm gateway.security.unsafe_sysfunc.openflag = 1 and that gateway.security.unsafe_sysfunc.blacklist lists the dangerous functions your policy requires (e.g. sleep, benchmark, load_file). openflag = 0 or an empty/incomplete denylist is a finding.

remediation.command: Ensure unsafe function interception is enabled and extend the denylist as needed: { "Name": "gateway.security.unsafe_sysfunc.openflag", "value": "1" }

title: Ensure OSS Sensitive Information Masking Is Enabled
description: TDSQL OSS provides sensitive information masking that automatically hides sensitive fields such as passwords and keys in API responses and logs. Uses TDSQL_HOME (install directory with bin/, conf/, boot/, log/; default /data/tdsql); reads <TDSQL_HOME>/conf/oss.json and passes when property_mask contains pwd, password, secretid, secretkey, token, secret_id, secret_key and keyring_kms_config. Also confirm the certificate fields and that interface_mask and znode_prefix_mask are present.
reference: CIS Tencent TDSQL 10.3.22 Benchmark v1.0.0 - 12.3 Ensure OSS Sensitive Information Masking Is Enabled

audit.command: f="${TDSQL_HOME:-/data/tdsql}/conf/oss.json"; [ -r "$f" ] || exit 1; v=$(grep -A3 '"property_mask"' "$f" | tr -d '\n'); [ -n "$v" ] || { echo missing; exit 0; }; for k in pwd password secretid secretkey token secret_id secret_key keyring_kms_config; do printf '%s' "$v" | grep -q "$k" || { echo "missing $k"; exit 0; }; done; echo compliant

remediation.command: Extend the property_mask value in oss.json, e.g. { "name": "property_mask", "value": "pwd,password,secretid,secretkey,token,secret_id,secret_key,<certificate fields>,keyring_kms_config" }, and restart OSS.

title: Ensure the Alerting Mechanism Is Enabled and Configured
description: HA primary-replica switchover Critical An instance underwent a switchover Backup failure Major A data backup task failed Insufficient disk space Critical Data directory disk usage exceeded the threshold ZK connection anomaly Critical Metadata service connection interrupted VIP anomaly Critical Virtual IP switched or lost 3.
reference: CIS Tencent TDSQL 10.3.22 Benchmark v1.0.0 - 12.4 Ensure the Alerting Mechanism Is Enabled and Configured

audit.command: In the TDSQL management platform confirm alert notification channels (email, SMS, WeCom, etc.) and recipients are configured, all Critical-level alert types (node/instance down, primary switch, replication delay, disk usage, backup failure) are enabled, and aggregation/escalation policies exist. Missing channels or disabled critical alerts are a finding.

remediation.command: 1. Configure alert recipients and channels. 2. Ensure all Critical-level alerts are enabled. 3. Configure alert aggregation and escalation policies.

title: Ensure Temporary System Account Passwords Are Cleaned Up
description: TDSQL creates temporary system accounts during certain management operations (such as privilege migration and DCN synchronization). After the operation completes, temporary accounts should be cleaned up. Runs the mysql client against the TDSQL data node selected by TDSQL_MYSQL_OPTS (e.g. "-h10.0.0.5 -P4001 -utdsql_audit"); keep the password in ~/.my.cnf or a login path rather than MYSQL_PWD or the command line (see 1.4 and 1.5).
reference: CIS Tencent TDSQL 10.3.22 Benchmark v1.0.0 - 12.6 Ensure Temporary System Account Passwords Are Cleaned Up

audit.command: out=$(mysql ${TDSQL_MYSQL_OPTS:-} -NBe "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mysql.user WHERE User LIKE '%tmp%' OR User LIKE '%temp%'" 2>/dev/null) || exit 1; printf '%s\n' "$out"

remediation.command: DROP USER IF EXISTS '<temporary account>'@'<host>'; (e.g. 'tdsqlsys_auth_tmp'@'%') and add periodic temporary-account cleanup to inspections.

title: Ensure OSS Super User Password Auto-Rotation Is Enabled
description: The OSS super user (osssuper) supports automatic password rotation (<super_user ... rotation="1"/> in scheduler.xml). When enabled, OSS automatically resets the super user password on a preset cycle and writes the new password back to the configuration in encrypted form.
reference: CIS Tencent TDSQL 10.3.22 Benchmark v1.0.0 - 12.8 Ensure OSS Super User Password Auto-Rotation Is Enabled

audit.command: Run grep '<super_user' <tdsql>/conf/scheduler.xml and confirm the element has rotation="1" (and an encrypted pwd that differs from the install template). rotation="0" or a missing attribute is a finding.

remediation.command: <super_user username="osssuper" pwd="<encrypted_strong_password>" host="10.0.0.0/8" rotation="1"/>

title: Ensure Appropriate Core Dump Limits Are Set
description: Core dumps of TDSQL processes may contain sensitive data (encryption keys, passwords, query data). Core dump generation should be restricted in production. Note: TDSQL's start.sh sets ulimit -c unlimited by default.
reference: CIS Tencent TDSQL 10.3.22 Benchmark v1.0.0 - 1.7 Ensure Appropriate Core Dump Limits Are Set

audit.command: Run ulimit -c for the TDSQL service account, cat /proc/sys/kernel/core_pattern and grep -r 'ulimit.*-c' <tdsql>/bin/start.sh (TDSQL start.sh sets unlimited). Core dumps must either be disabled or written only to a restricted directory (e.g. /var/core/tdsql, mode 700, owned by tdsql) with a size limit set by policy.

remediation.command: # Create a restricted core dump directory mkdir -p /var/core/tdsql chmod 700 /var/core/tdsql chown tdsql:tdsql /var/core/tdsql echo 'kernel.core_pattern = /var/core/tdsql/core.%e.%p.%t' >> /etc/sysctl.conf sysctl -p # Modify start.sh for production: # From: ulimit -c unlimited # To: ulimit -c 0 (or a reasonable limit)

title: Ensure Unnecessary System Services Are Disabled on TDSQL Hosts
description: TDSQL hosts should run only the necessary services. Unnecessary services increase the attack surface.
reference: CIS Tencent TDSQL 10.3.22 Benchmark v1.0.0 - 1.8 Ensure Unnecessary System Services Are Disabled on TDSQL Hosts

audit.command: Run systemctl list-unit-files --type=service --state=enabled and ss -tlnp on every TDSQL host. Only TDSQL components (mysqld, oss_server, scheduler, zookeeper, gateway/proxy, agents) and required OS services may be enabled or listening; services such as cups, avahi-daemon, bluetooth or telnet are a finding.

remediation.command: # Disable unnecessary services systemctl disable --now cups avahi-daemon bluetooth telnet.socket

title: Ensure the TDSQL Installation Directory Structure Is Well-Organized
description: TDSQL should follow a well-organized directory structure: <tdsql_root>/ ├── bin/ # Executables and scripts ├── conf/ # Configuration files (scheduler.xml, oss.json, etc.) ├── boot/ # Boot modules and SSL certificates ├── data/ # Runtime data ├── log/ # Log files ├── sql/ # Database schema files └── lib/ # Shared libraries
reference: CIS Tencent TDSQL 10.3.22 Benchmark v1.0.0 - 2.8 Ensure the TDSQL Installation Directory Structure Is Well-Organized

audit.command: # Verify the directory structure ls -la /path/to/tdsql/ # Ensure there are no data files in the binary directory find /path/to/tdsql/bin/ -name '*.dat' -o -name '*.ibd' # Ensure there are no executable files in the data directory find /path/to/tdsql/data/ -executable -type f

remediation.command: Install using the standard TDSQL installation procedure via install.sh, which creates the canonical directory structure.

title: Ensure a DDL Change Management Process Is Established
description: Schema changes (DDL) should follow a formal change management process. TDSQL specifies SQL files in the sql/ directory named V[version]_[batch]__[description].sql, which are required to be idempotent and re-entrant.
reference: CIS Tencent TDSQL 10.3.22 Benchmark v1.0.0 - 2.9 Ensure a DDL Change Management Process Is Established

audit.command: # Verify that SQL change files follow the naming convention ls /path/to/tdsql/sql/*/V*.sql # Verify that changes are under version control git log --oneline /path/to/tdsql/sql/

remediation.command: Establish a DDL change management policy: Submit all changes as SQL files in the V[version]_[batch]__[description].sql format Changes must be idempotent Require review and approval before deployment Test in a non-production environment first

title: Ensure `sql_mode` Contains `STRICT_ALL_TABLES`
description: Enabling STRICT_ALL_TABLES mode ensures that MySQL performs strict data type checking during data insertion/update, rather than silently truncating or converting values. Runs the mysql client against the TDSQL data node selected by TDSQL_MYSQL_OPTS (e.g. "-h10.0.0.5 -P4001 -utdsql_audit"); keep the password in ~/.my.cnf or a login path rather than MYSQL_PWD or the command line (see 1.4 and 1.5).
reference: CIS Tencent TDSQL 10.3.22 Benchmark v1.0.0 - 4.2 Ensure `sql_mode` Contains `STRICT_ALL_TABLES`

audit.command: out=$(mysql ${TDSQL_MYSQL_OPTS:-} -NBe "SELECT CASE WHEN FIND_IN_SET('STRICT_ALL_TABLES', @@global.sql_mode) > 0 THEN 'compliant' ELSE 'noncompliant' END" 2>/dev/null) || exit 1; printf '%s\n' "$out"

remediation.guidance: Add STRICT_ALL_TABLES to sql_mode via the OSS management platform, e.g. SET GLOBAL sql_mode = 'STRICT_TRANS_TABLES,NO_ENGINE_SUBSTITUTION,STRICT_ALL_TABLES'; and persist it in the parameter template.

title: Ensure the TXSQL Recycle Bin Is Enabled
description: TXSQL provides a recycle bin mechanism (txsql_recycle_bin_enabled): when a user executes DROP TABLE or TRUNCATE TABLE, the table is not physically deleted immediately but is renamed and moved into the recycle bin, retained for txsql_recycle_bin_retention seconds before being cleaned up by the background scheduler (txsql_recycle_scheduler_interval). Runs the mysql client against the TDSQL data node selected by TDSQL_MYSQL_OPTS (e.g. "-h10.0.0.5 -P4001 -utdsql_audit"); keep the password in ~/.my.cnf or a login path rather than MYSQL_PWD or the command line (see 1.4 and 1.5). Passes when txsql_recycle_bin_enabled is ON; also confirm txsql_recycle_bin_retention / txsql_recycle_scheduler_interval and gateway.mode.recycle_bin.recycle_bin_switch = 1.
reference: CIS Tencent TDSQL 10.3.22 Benchmark v1.0.0 - 4.13 Ensure the TXSQL Recycle Bin Is Enabled

audit.command: out=$(mysql ${TDSQL_MYSQL_OPTS:-} -NBe "SHOW GLOBAL VARIABLES LIKE 'txsql_recycle_bin_enabled'" 2>/dev/null) || exit 1; v=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | awk -F'\t' '$1 == "txsql_recycle_bin_enabled" {print toupper($2)}'); case "$v" in ON|1) echo compliant;; *) echo "value '$v'";; esac

remediation.command: SET GLOBAL txsql_recycle_bin_enabled = ON; SET GLOBAL txsql_recycle_bin_retention = 604800; SET GLOBAL txsql_recycle_scheduler_interval = 60; and persist them in the parameter template.

title: Ensure Audit and Gateway Log Limits Preserve Complete Statements
description: audit_txsql_truncate_length limits the SQL text written by the TXSQL audit facility, while gateway.log.interface.sql_size limits the message length processed by the compute-node logging path. Both limits must be large enough to preserve complete security-relevant statements throughout the audit pipeline.
reference: CIS Tencent TDSQL 10.3.22 Benchmark v1.0.0 - 6.2 Ensure Audit and Gateway Log Limits Preserve Complete Statements

audit.command: Run SHOW GLOBAL VARIABLES LIKE 'audit_txsql_truncate_length'; on the data nodes and grep -R gateway.log.interface.sql_size <tdsql>/conf/ (or check the management platform) for the compute nodes. Both must be at least 2048 bytes and large enough for the longest security-relevant statements; verify a long test statement is not truncated centrally.

remediation.command: Set the data-node limit through the instance parameter configuration: SET GLOBAL audit_txsql_truncate_length = 4096; Set gateway.log.interface.sql_size to the same or a larger value through the compute-node settings, then validate the complete record at the configured Kafka, Elasticsearch, DBbrain, or SIEM destination.

title: Ensure `log_error_verbosity` Is Reasonably Set
description: log_error_verbosity controls the verbosity of the error log: 1 = errors only, 2 = errors + warnings, 3 = errors + warnings + information. Runs the mysql client against the TDSQL data node selected by TDSQL_MYSQL_OPTS (e.g. "-h10.0.0.5 -P4001 -utdsql_audit"); keep the password in ~/.my.cnf or a login path rather than MYSQL_PWD or the command line (see 1.4 and 1.5). Passes when log_error_verbosity is 2 or 3.
reference: CIS Tencent TDSQL 10.3.22 Benchmark v1.0.0 - 6.3 Ensure `log_error_verbosity` Is Reasonably Set

audit.command: out=$(mysql ${TDSQL_MYSQL_OPTS:-} -NBe "SELECT CASE WHEN @@global.log_error_verbosity IN (2, 3) THEN 'compliant' ELSE 'noncompliant' END" 2>/dev/null) || exit 1; printf '%s\n' "$out"

remediation.guidance: SET GLOBAL log_error_verbosity = 3; and persist it in the parameter template.

title: Ensure the Slow Query Log Is Enabled
description: The slow query log records SQL statements whose execution time exceeds a specified threshold, helping to identify performance issues and potential DoS attacks. Runs the mysql client against the TDSQL data node selected by TDSQL_MYSQL_OPTS (e.g. "-h10.0.0.5 -P4001 -utdsql_audit"); keep the password in ~/.my.cnf or a login path rather than MYSQL_PWD or the command line (see 1.4 and 1.5). Passes when slow_query_log is ON and long_query_time is between 1 and 10 seconds.
reference: CIS Tencent TDSQL 10.3.22 Benchmark v1.0.0 - 6.5 Ensure the Slow Query Log Is Enabled

audit.command: out=$(mysql ${TDSQL_MYSQL_OPTS:-} -NBe "SELECT CASE WHEN @@global.slow_query_log = 1 AND @@global.long_query_time BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN 'compliant' ELSE 'noncompliant' END" 2>/dev/null) || exit 1; printf '%s\n' "$out"

remediation.guidance: SET GLOBAL slow_query_log = ON; SET GLOBAL long_query_time = 2;

title: Ensure Sensitive OSS Query Interfaces Are Audited
description: OSS audits write-type operations by default, but query interfaces can disclose account, topology, KMS, or other sensitive management information. Organizations must either audit all query interfaces or maintain an approved set of sensitive query interfaces that are explicitly audited.
reference: CIS Tencent TDSQL 10.3.22 Benchmark v1.0.0 - 6.10 Ensure Sensitive OSS Query Interfaces Are Audited

audit.command: Confirm one of the following through the supported OSS configuration: 1. query_interfaces_logged_in_audit = 1; or 2. query_interfaces_logged_in_audit = 0 and query_interfaces_audit_set contains the complete approved sensitive- interface list. At minimum, evaluate interfaces exposing users, cluster topology, KMS configuration, OSS users, and security settings. Invoke a non-destructive approved interface and confirm its record reaches both the OSS audit store and centralized destination.

remediation.command: Enable full query auditing or configure the reviewed sensitive-interface set through the supported OSS configuration mechanism. Representative interfaces include TDSQL.ListUser, TDSQL.GetSetInfo, TDSQL.GetKmsConfig, TDSQL.GetClusterName, and TDSQL.GetOssUsers; derive the authoritative list from the deployed version and data-classification requirements.

title: Ensure `max_connections` Is Capacity-Planned and Monitored
description: max_connections must be sized from instance capacity, per-connection memory, application pool limits, administrative reserve, and measured peak concurrency, and monitored with current and rejected connections.
reference: CIS Tencent TDSQL 10.3.22 Benchmark v1.0.0 - 9.5 Ensure `max_connections` Is Capacity-Planned and Monitored

audit.command: SHOW GLOBAL VARIABLES LIKE 'max_connections'; SHOW GLOBAL STATUS LIKE 'Max_used_connections'; SHOW GLOBAL STATUS LIKE 'Threads_connected'; SHOW GLOBAL STATUS LIKE 'Connection_errors_max_connections'; Review a representative peak period and confirm an approved capacity calculation, coordinated application/Gateway pool totals, an administrative reserve, and alerts for utilization and rejected connections.

remediation.command: Calculate the approved limit from workload and memory evidence, coordinate application pool limits, and persist it through a TDSQL custom parameter template. Do not apply a generic value such as 2048 without capacity testing.

title: Ensure `max_connect_errors` Is Reasonably Set
description: max_connect_errors controls the threshold of consecutive connection errors from the same host after which MySQL automatically blocks subsequent connections from that host. Runs the mysql client against the TDSQL data node selected by TDSQL_MYSQL_OPTS (e.g. "-h10.0.0.5 -P4001 -utdsql_audit"); keep the password in ~/.my.cnf or a login path rather than MYSQL_PWD or the command line (see 1.4 and 1.5). Passes when max_connect_errors is 100 or less (TDSQL default 2000).
reference: CIS Tencent TDSQL 10.3.22 Benchmark v1.0.0 - 9.6 Ensure `max_connect_errors` Is Reasonably Set

audit.command: out=$(mysql ${TDSQL_MYSQL_OPTS:-} -NBe "SELECT CASE WHEN @@global.max_connect_errors <= 100 THEN 'compliant' ELSE 'noncompliant' END" 2>/dev/null) || exit 1; printf '%s\n' "$out"

title: Ensure Cross-Shard Operations Are Appropriately Controlled
description: tdsql_trx_cross_shard_op_whitelist controls the types of cross-shard operations allowed within a distributed transaction.
reference: CIS Tencent TDSQL 10.3.22 Benchmark v1.0.0 - 11.4 Ensure Cross-Shard Operations Are Appropriately Controlled

audit.command: On the SQLEngine run SHOW VARIABLES LIKE 'tdsql_trx_cross_shard_op_whitelist'; If the business does not require cross-shard writes the value must be READ; the default READ,WRITE is acceptable only where cross-shard writes are a documented requirement.

remediation.command: Configure the allowed operation types according to business needs, minimizing cross- shard write operations: If the business does not require cross-shard writes, set it to READ. If cross-shard writes are required, keep the default READ,WRITE.

title: Ensure the Health Check Interval Is Reasonable
description: check_interv al 300s 60-120s Lower the interval to speed up fault detection proxy_hang_t ime 150s 60-120s Lower the Proxy hang determination time oc_hang_time 200s 60-120s Lower the OC hang determination time Assessed manually here: the benchmark check is environment-specific and cannot be evaluated reliably by a single command.

audit.command: Check check_interval (default 300 s), proxy_hang_time (default 150 s) and oc_hang_time (default 200 s) in manager.json. Values must be aligned with the business SLA (failure detection fast enough for the required RTO); values longer than the SLA allows are a finding.

reference: CIS Tencent TDSQL 10.3.22 Benchmark v1.0.0 - 12.7 Ensure ZooKeeper Orphan Node Cleanup Is Configured

audit.command: # Check scheduler.xml grep -E '(clear_zknode|alarm_zknode)' /path/to/tdsql/conf/scheduler.xml # Check for residual historical nodes in ZK (should not exceed recent counts) zkCli.sh -server <zk_ip>:<port> ls /tdsql/job ls /tdsql/alarm

title: Ensure Manager Resource Monitoring Thresholds Are Configured
description: The TDSQL Agent provides proactive resource monitoring (mysqlagent_template.xml): <myisam open="1" interval="3600"/> - check whether MyISAM tables have been created <long_trx open="1" interval="60"/> - monitor long transactions <no_primarykey open="1" interval="3600"/> - monitor tables without a primary key <checkdisk open="1" interval="10"/> - disk space check <checklog open="1" interval="..."/> - monitor critical ...
reference: CIS Tencent TDSQL 10.3.22 Benchmark v1.0.0 - 12.11 Ensure Manager Resource Monitoring Thresholds Are Configured

audit.command: Run grep -A20 '<monitor>' <tdsql>/agent/conf/mysqlagent.xml (and the HeartBeat section). The myisam, long_trx, no_primarykey, checkdisk and checklog items and binlog_checksum must each have open="1" with suitable intervals; any disabled item is a finding.

remediation.command: <monitor> <myisam open="1" interval="3600"/> <long_trx open="1" interval="60"/> <no_primarykey open="1" interval="3600"/> <checkdisk open="1" interval="10"/> <checklog open="1" interval="60"/> </monitor> <HeartBeat> <Other switch="1" interval="3"> <binlog_checksum open="1" err_count="-1" err_time="10"/> </Other> </HeartBeat>
